purpose: Normalize Android CarrierConfig/carrier identification and Apple Carrier Settings into a shared evidence-scoped model that plugs into Phase154 carrier_configuration without pretending the two platforms expose identical internals.

reload_triggers: SIM load / boot / SIM hot swap

evidence_boundaries: Do not store actual IMSI/GID subscriber values; only record matching mechanisms or non-secret carrier metadata.
CarrierConfig support does not prove runtime success.
Carrier ID is an identification input, not a compatibility verdict.
AOSP CarrierConfig content does not prove an OEM/carrier build has adopted the same value.

update_behavior: carrier settings updates can improve cellular connectivity/performance
updates can add support for features such as 5G or Wi-Fi Calling
new SIM/eSIM may require settings for the new carrier

evidence_boundaries: Carrier Settings Version is device-observed state unless an official source publishes the exact version.
A newer carrier settings version is not automatically equivalent to better compatibility.
Carrier settings capability does not prove voice/data/SMS/IMS runtime success.
Do not infer internal carrier-bundle contents that Apple does not expose publicly.
